tools.name: get_route_vignettes
tools.description: Which motorway vignettes a passenger-car trip between two places in Europe needs, the cheapest product covering the dates in each country, official prices plus service fee in EUR, tolls on the route that are not vignettes, and an order link with the route pre-filled.

from.description: Start: a city (e.g. Munich, München, Praha, Kraków) or an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. DE).

to.description: Destination: a city or an ISO country code.

start.description: First day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: tomorrow.

end.description: Last day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: start + 9 days.

lang.description: Language of the order page linked in orderUrl.

tools.name: list_vignette_countries
tools.description: Every country with a car vignette we cover (AT, CZ, SK, HU, SI, RO, BG, CH) and all its products with official price and total in EUR.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: City names (and local spellings) accepted by get_route_vignettes. ISO country codes are accepted too.
